mealAnalysis.guidance_message: This appears to be a serving of cooked white rice, which is primarily a refined carbohydrate with limited fiber and can raise blood sugar levels relatively quickly in someone with diabetes. It is best to avoid or strictly limit this meal, opting for whole grain rice, quinoa, or another high-fiber alternative instead.
mealAnalysis.meal_description: A plain serving of cooked white rice on a plate, likely prepared with rice and water, with possible added salt.
